ayahs.ar: الٓرٰࣞ كِتٰبٌ اُحۡكِمَتۡ اٰيٰتُهٗ ثُمَّ فُصِّلَتۡ مِنۡ لَّدُنۡ حَكِيۡمٍ خَبِيۡرٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Alif-Laaam-Raa; Kitaabun uhkimat Aayaatuhoo summa fussilat mil ladun Hakeemin Khabeer
ayahs.en: Alif, Lam, Ra. [This is] a Book whose verses are perfected and then presented in detail from [one who is] Wise and Acquainted.

ayahs.ar: اَلَّا تَعۡبُدُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا اللّٰهَؕ اِنَّنِيۡ لَكُمۡ مِّنۡهُ نَذِيۡرٌ وَّبَشِيۡرٌۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Allaa ta'budooo illal laah; innanee lakum minhu nazeerunw wa basheer
ayahs.en: [Through a messenger, saying], "Do not worship except Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a warner and a bringer of good tidings,"

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنِ اسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡا رَبَّكُمۡ ثُمَّ تُوۡبُوۡ٘ا اِلَيۡهِ يُمَتِّعۡكُمۡ مَّتَاعًا حَسَنًا اِلٰ٘ي اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّي وَّيُؤۡتِ كُلَّ ذِيۡ فَضۡلٍ فَضۡلَهٗؕ وَاِنۡ تَوَلَّوۡا فَاِنِّيۡ٘ اَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ كَبِيۡرٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa anis taghfiroo Rabbakum summa toobooo ilaihi yumatti'kum mataa'an hasanan ilaaa ajalim musammanw wa yu'ti kulla zee fadlin fadlahoo wa in tawallaw fa inneee akhaafu 'alaikum 'azaaba Yawmin Kabeer
ayahs.en: And [saying], "Seek forgiveness of your Lord and repent to Him, [and] He will let you enjoy a good provision for a specified term and give every doer of favor his favor. But if you turn away, then indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a great Day.

ayahs.ar: اِلَي اللّٰهِ مَرۡجِعُكُمۡۚ وَهُوَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Ilal laahi marji'ukum wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shai'in Qadeer
ayahs.en: To Allah is your return, and He is over all things competent."

ayahs.ar: اَلَا٘ اِنَّهُمۡ يَثۡنُوۡنَ صُدُوۡرَهُمۡ لِيَسۡتَخۡفُوۡا مِنۡهُؕ اَلَا حِيۡنَ يَسۡتَغۡشُوۡنَ ثِيَابَهُمۡۙ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّوۡنَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُوۡنَۚ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيۡمٌۭ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوۡرِ
ayahs.tl: Alaa innahum yasnoona sudoorahum liyastakhfoo minh; alaa heena yastaghshoona siyaabahum ya'lamu maa yusiroona wa maa yu'linoon; innahoo 'aleemum bizaatis sudoor
ayahs.en: Unquestionably, they the disbelievers turn away their breasts to hide themselves from Him. Unquestionably, [even] when they cover themselves in their clothing, Allah knows what they conceal and what they declare. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا مِنۡ دَآبَّةٍ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ اِلَّا عَلَي اللّٰهِ رِزۡقُهَا وَ يَعۡلَمُ مُسۡتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسۡتَوۡدَعَهَاؕ كُلٌّ فِيۡ كِتٰبٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa min daaabbatin fil ardi illaa 'alal laahi rizquhaa wa ya'lamu mustaqarrahaa wa mustawda'ahaa; kullun fee Kitaabim Mubeen
ayahs.en: And there is no creature on earth but that upon Allah is its provision, and He knows its place of dwelling and place of storage. All is in a clear register.

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ فِيۡ سِتَّةِ اَيَّامٍ وَّكَانَ عَرۡشُهٗ عَلَي الۡمَآءِ لِيَبۡلُوَكُمۡ اَيُّكُمۡ اَحۡسَنُ عَمَلًاؕ وَلَئِنۡ قُلۡتَ اِنَّكُمۡ مَّبۡعُوۡثُوۡنَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ الۡمَوۡتِ لَيَقُوۡلَنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡ٘ا اِنۡ هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا سِحۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa Huwal lazee khalaqas samaawaati wal alrda fee sittati aiyaaminw wa kaana 'Arshuhoo alal maaa'i liyablu wakum aiyukum ahsanu 'amalaa; wa la'in qulta innakum mab'oosoona mim ba'dil mawti la yaqoolanal lazeena kafaroo in haazaaa illaa sihrum mubeen
ayahs.en: And it is He who created the heavens and the earth in six days - and His Throne had been upon water - that He might test you as to which of you is best in deed. But if you say, "Indeed, you are resurrected after death," those who disbelieve will surely say, "This is not but obvious magic."

ayahs.ar: وَلَئِنۡ اَخَّرۡنَا عَنۡهُمُ الۡعَذَابَ اِلٰ٘ي اُمَّةٍ مَّعۡدُوۡدَةٍ لَّيَقُوۡلُنَّ مَا يَحۡبِسُهٗؕ اَلَا يَوۡمَ يَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ لَيۡسَ مَصۡرُوۡفًا عَنۡهُمۡ وَحَاقَ بِهِمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wala'in akhkharnaa 'anhumul 'azaaba ilaaa ummatim ma'doodatil la yaqoolunna maa yahbisuh; alaa yawma yaateehim laisa masroofan 'anhum wa haaqa bihim maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
ayahs.en: And if We hold back from them the punishment for a limited time, they will surely say, "What detains it?" Unquestionably, on the Day it comes to them, it will not be averted from them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

ayahs.ar: وَلَئِنۡ اَذَقۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ مِنَّا رَحۡمَةً ثُمَّ نَزَعۡنٰهَا مِنۡهُۚ اِنَّهٗ لَيَـُٔوۡسٌ كَفُوۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa la'in azaqnal insaana minnaa rahmatan summa naza'naahaa minhu, innahoo laya'oosun kafoor
ayahs.en: And if We give man a taste of mercy from Us and then We withdraw it from him, indeed, he is despairing and ungrateful.

ayahs.ar: وَلَئِنۡ اَذَقۡنٰهُ نَعۡمَآءَ بَعۡدَ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتۡهُ لَيَقُوۡلَنَّ ذَهَبَ السَّيِّاٰتُ عَنِّيۡؕ اِنَّهٗ لَفَرِحٌ فَخُوۡرٌۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wala'in azaqnaahu na'maaa'a ba'da darraaa'a massat hu la yaqoolanna zahabas saiyiaatu 'anneee; innahoo lafarihun fakhoor
ayahs.en: But if We give him a taste of favor after hardship has touched him, he will surely say, "Bad times have left me." Indeed, he is exultant and boastful -

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ صَبَرُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ مَّغۡفِرَةٌ وَّاَجۡرٌ كَبِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Illal lazeena sabaroo wa 'amilus saalihaati ulaaa'ika lahum maghfiratunw wa ajrun kabeer
ayahs.en: Except for those who are patient and do righteous deeds; those will have forgiveness and great reward.

ayahs.ar: فَلَعَلَّكَ تَارِكٌۭ بَعۡضَ مَا يُوۡحٰ٘ي اِلَيۡكَ وَضَآئِقٌۭ بِهٖ صَدۡرُكَ اَنۡ يَّقُوۡلُوۡا لَوۡلَا٘ اُنۡزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ كَنۡزٌ اَوۡ جَآءَ مَعَهٗ مَلَكٌؕ اِنَّمَا٘ اَنۡتَ نَذِيۡرٌؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ وَّكِيۡلٌؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Fala'allaka taarikum ba'da maa yoohaaa ilaika wa daaa'iqum bihee sadruka ai yaqooloo law laaa unzila 'alaihi kanzun aw jaaa'a ma'ahoo malak; innamaa anta nazeer; wallaahu 'alaa kulli shai'inw wakeel
ayahs.en: Then would you possibly leave [out] some of what is revealed to you, or is your breast constrained by it because they say, "Why has there not been sent down to him a treasure or come with him an angel?" But you are only a warner. And Allah is Disposer of all things.

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ افۡتَرٰىهُؕ قُلۡ فَاۡتُوۡا بِعَشۡرِ سُوَرٍ مِّثۡلِهٖ مُفۡتَرَيٰتٍ وَّادۡعُوۡا مَنِ اسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Am yaqooloonaf taraahu qul faatoo bi'ashri Suwarim mislihee muftarayaatinw wad'oo manis tata'tum min doonil laahi in kuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.en: Or do they say, "He invented it"? Say, "Then bring ten surahs like it that have been invented and call upon [for assistance] whomever you can besides Allah, if you should be truthful."

ayahs.ar: فَاِلَّمۡ يَسۡتَجِيۡبُوۡا لَكُمۡ فَاعۡلَمُوۡ٘ا اَنَّمَا٘ اُنۡزِلَ بِعِلۡمِ اللّٰهِ وَاَنۡ لَّا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَۚ فَهَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ مُّسۡلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa il lam yastajeeboo lakum fa'lamooo annamaaa unzilla bi'ilmil laahi wa al laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa fahal antum muslimoon
ayahs.en: And if they do not respond to you - then know that the Qur'an was revealed with the knowledge of Allah and that there is no deity except Him. Then, would you [not] be Muslims?

ayahs.ar: مَنۡ كَانَ يُرِيۡدُ الۡحَيٰوةَ الدُّنۡيَا وَزِيۡنَتَهَا نُوَفِّ اِلَيۡهِمۡ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا وَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا لَا يُبۡخَسُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Man kaana yureedul hayaatad dunyaa zeenatahaa nuwaffi ilaihim a'maa lahum feehaa wa hum feehaa laa yubkhasoon
ayahs.en: Whoever desires the life of this world and its adornments - We fully repay them for their deeds therein, and they therein will not be deprived.

ayahs.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ لَيۡسَ لَهُمۡ فِي الۡاٰخِرَةِ اِلَّا النَّارُؗۖ وَحَبِطَ مَا صَنَعُوۡا فِيۡهَا وَبٰطِلٌ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Ulaaa'ikal lazeena laisa lahum fil Aakhirati illan Naaru wa habita maa sana'oo feehaa wa baatilum maa kaanoo ya'maloon
ayahs.en: Those are the ones for whom there is not in the Hereafter but the Fire. And lost is what they did therein, and worthless is what they used to do.

ayahs.ar: اَفَمَنۡ كَانَ عَلٰي بَيِّنَةٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّهٖ وَيَتۡلُوۡهُ شَاهِدٌ مِّنۡهُ وَمِنۡ قَبۡلِهٖ كِتٰبُ مُوۡسٰ٘ي اِمَامًا وَّرَحۡمَةًؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِهٖؕ وَمَنۡ يَّكۡفُرۡ بِهٖ مِنَ الۡاَحۡزَابِ فَالنَّارُ مَوۡعِدُهٗۚ فَلَا تَكُ فِيۡ مِرۡيَةٍ مِّنۡهُࣗ اِنَّهُ الۡحَقُّ مِنۡ رَّبِّكَ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Afaman kaana 'alas baiyinatim mir Rabbihee wa yatloohu shaahidum minhu wa min qablihee Kitaabu Moosaaa imaamanw wa rahmah; ulaaa 'ika yu'minoona bih; wa mai yakfur bihee minal Ahzaabi fan Naaru maw'iduh; falaa taku fee miryatim minh; innahul haqqu mir Rabbika wa laakinna aksaran naasi laa yu'minoon
ayahs.en: So is one who [stands] upon a clear evidence from his Lord [like the aforementioned]? And a witness from Him follows it, and before it was the Scripture of Moses to lead and as mercy. Those [believers in the former revelations] believe in the Qur'an. But whoever disbelieves in it from the [various] factions - the Fire is his promised destination. So be not in doubt about it. Indeed, it is the truth from your Lord, but most of the people do not believe.

ayahs.ar: وَمَنۡ اَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ افۡتَرٰي عَلَي اللّٰهِ كَذِبًاؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ يُعۡرَضُوۡنَ عَلٰي رَبِّهِمۡ وَيَقُوۡلُ الۡاَشۡهَادُ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَذَبُوۡا عَلٰي رَبِّهِمۡۚ اَلَا لَعۡنَةُ اللّٰهِ عَلَي الظّٰلِمِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa man azlamu mimmanif taraa 'alal laahi kazibaa; ulaaa'ika yu'radoona 'alaa Rabbihim wa yaqoolul ashhaa duhaaa'ulaaa'il lazeena kazaboo 'alaa Rabbihim; alaa la'natul laahi alaz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: And who is more unjust than he who invents a lie about Allah? Those will be presented before their Lord, and the witnesses will say, "These are the ones who lied against their Lord." Unquestionably, the curse of Allah is upon the wrongdoers.

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ يَصُدُّوۡنَ عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ وَيَبۡغُوۡنَهَا عِوَجًاؕ وَهُمۡ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ هُمۡ كٰفِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Allazeena yasuddoona 'an sabeelil laahi wa yabghoonahaa 'iwajanw wa hum bil Aakhiratihum kaafiroon
ayahs.en: Who averted [people] from the way of Allah and sought to make it [seem] deviant while they, concerning the Hereafter, were disbelievers.

ayahs.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ لَمۡ يَكُوۡنُوۡا مُعۡجِزِيۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ اَوۡلِيَآءَۘ يُضٰعَفُ لَهُمُ الۡعَذَابُؕ مَا كَانُوۡا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ السَّمۡعَ وَمَا كَانُوۡا يُبۡصِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Ulaaa'ika lam yakoonoo mu'jizeena fil ardi wa maa kaana lahum min doonil laahi min awliyaaa'; yudaa'afu lahumul 'azaab; maa kaanoo yastatee'oonas sam'a wa maa kaanoo yubsiroon
ayahs.en: Those were not causing failure [to Allah] on earth, nor did they have besides Allah any protectors. For them the punishment will be multiplied. They were not able to hear, nor did they see.

ayahs.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ خَسِرُوۡ٘ا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَفۡتَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Ulaaa'ikal lazeena khasirooo anfusahum wa dalla 'anhum maa kaanoo yaftaroon
ayahs.en: Those are the ones who will have lost themselves, and lost from them is what they used to invent.

ayahs.ar: لَا جَرَمَ اَنَّهُمۡ فِي الۡاٰخِرَةِ هُمُ الۡاَخۡسَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Laa jarama annahum fil Aakhirati humul akhsaroon
ayahs.en: Assuredly, it is they in the Hereafter who will be the greatest losers.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَاَخۡبَتُوۡ٘ا اِلٰي رَبِّهِمۡۙ اُولٰٓئِكَ اَصۡحٰبُ الۡجَنَّةِۚ هُمۡ فِيۡهَا خٰلِدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati wa akhbatooo ilaa Rabbihim ulaaa'ika Ashaabul Jannati hum feehaa khaalidoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds and humbled themselves to their Lord - those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide eternally therein.

ayahs.ar: مَثَلُ الۡفَرِيۡقَيۡنِ كَالۡاَعۡمٰي وَالۡاَصَمِّ وَالۡبَصِيۡرِ وَالسَّمِيۡعِؕ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِيٰنِ مَثَلًاؕ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Masalul fareeqini kal a'maa wal asammi walbaseeri wassamee'; hal yastawiyaani masalaa; afalaa tazakkaroon
ayahs.en: The example of the two parties is like the blind and deaf, and the seeing and hearing. Are they equal in comparison? Then, will you not remember?

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوۡحًا اِلٰي قَوۡمِهٖ٘ؗ اِنِّيۡ لَكُمۡ نَذِيۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad arsalnaa Noohan ilaa qawmihee innee lakum nazeerum mubeen
ayahs.en: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Indeed, I am to you a clear warner

ayahs.ar: اَنۡ لَّا تَعۡبُدُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا اللّٰهَؕ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ اَلِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Al laa ta'budooo illal laaha inneee akhaafu 'alaikum 'azaaba Yawmin aleem
ayahs.en: That you not worship except Allah. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a painful day."

ayahs.ar: فَقَالَ الۡمَلَاُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا مِنۡ قَوۡمِهٖ مَا نَرٰىكَ اِلَّا بَشَرًا مِّثۡلَنَا وَمَا نَرٰىكَ اتَّبَعَكَ اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ اَرَاذِلُنَا بَادِيَ الرَّاۡيِۚ وَمَا نَرٰي لَكُمۡ عَلَيۡنَا مِنۡ فَضۡلٍۭ بَلۡ نَظُنُّكُمۡ كٰذِبِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Faqaalal mala ul lazeena kafaroo min qawmihee ma naraaka illaa basharam mislanaa wa maa naraakat taba'aka illal lazeena hum araazilunaa baadiyar raayi wa maa naraa lakum 'alainaa min fadlim bal nazunnukum kaazibeen
ayahs.en: So the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "We do not see you but as a man like ourselves, and we do not see you followed except by those who are the lowest of us [and] at first suggestion. And we do not see in you over us any merit; rather, we think you are liars."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اَرَءَيۡتُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُ عَلٰي بَيِّنَةٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّيۡ وَاٰتٰىنِيۡ رَحۡمَةً مِّنۡ عِنۡدِهٖ فَعُمِّيَتۡ عَلَيۡكُمۡؕ اَنُلۡزِمُكُمُوۡهَا وَاَنۡتُمۡ لَهَا كٰرِهُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala yaa qawmi ara'aitum in kuntu 'alaa baiyinatim mir Rabbee wa aataanee rahmatam min 'indihee fa'um miyat 'alaikum anulzimuku moohaa wa antum lahaa kaarihoon
ayahs.en: He said, "O my people have you considered: if I should be upon clear evidence from my Lord while He has given me mercy from Himself but it has been made unapparent to you, should we force it upon you while you are averse to it?

ayahs.ar: وَيٰقَوۡمِ لَا٘ اَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مَالًاؕ اِنۡ اَجۡرِيَ اِلَّا عَلَي اللّٰهِ وَمَا٘ اَنَا بِطَارِدِ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡاؕ اِنَّهُمۡ مُّلٰقُوۡا رَبِّهِمۡ وَلٰكِنِّيۡ٘ اَرٰىكُمۡ قَوۡمًا تَجۡهَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa yaa qawmi laaa as'alukum 'alaihi maalan in ajriya illaa 'alal laah; wa maaa ana bitaaridil lazeena aamanoo; innahum mulaaqoo Rabbihim wa laakinneee araakum qawman tajhaloon
ayahs.en: And O my people, I ask not of you for it any wealth. My reward is not but from Allah. And I am not one to drive away those who have believed. Indeed, they will meet their Lord, but I see that you are a people behaving ignorantly.

ayahs.ar: وَيٰقَوۡمِ مَنۡ يَّنۡصُرُنِيۡ مِنَ اللّٰهِ اِنۡ طَرَدۡتُّهُمۡؕ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa yaa qawmi mai yansurunee minal laahi in tarattuhum; afalaa tazak karoon
ayahs.en: And O my people, who would protect me from Allah if I drove them away? Then will you not be reminded?

ayahs.ar: وَلَا٘ اَقُوۡلُ لَكُمۡ عِنۡدِيۡ خَزَآئِنُ اللّٰهِ وَلَا٘ اَعۡلَمُ الۡغَيۡبَ وَلَا٘ اَقُوۡلُ اِنِّيۡ مَلَكٌ وَّلَا٘ اَقُوۡلُ لِلَّذِيۡنَ تَزۡدَرِيۡ٘ اَعۡيُنُكُمۡ لَنۡ يُّؤۡتِيَهُمُ اللّٰهُ خَيۡرًاؕ اَللّٰهُ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا فِيۡ٘ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡۖ اِنِّيۡ٘ اِذًا لَّمِنَ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laa aqoolu lakum 'indee khazaa'inul laahi wa laaa a'lamul ghaiba wa laa aqoolu inee malakunw wa laaa aqoolu lillazeena tazdareee a'yunukum lai yu'tiyahumul laahu khairan Allaahu a'lamu bimaa feee anfusihim innee izal laminaz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: And I do not tell you that I have the depositories [containing the provision] of Allah or that I know the unseen, nor do I tell you that I am an angel, nor do I say of those upon whom your eyes look down that Allah will never grant them any good. Allah is most knowing of what is within their souls. Indeed, I would then be among the wrongdoers."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰنُوۡحُ قَدۡ جَادَلۡتَنَا فَاَكۡثَرۡتَ جِدَالَنَا فَاۡتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا٘ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo yaa Noohu qad jaadaltanaa fa aksarta jidaalanaa faatinaa bimaa ta'idunaaa in kunta minas saadiqeen
ayahs.en: They said, "O Noah, you have disputed us and been frequent in dispute of us. So bring us what you threaten us, if you should be of the truthful."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اِنَّمَا يَاۡتِيۡكُمۡ بِهِ اللّٰهُ اِنۡ شَآءَ وَمَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ بِمُعۡجِزِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala innamaa yaateekum bihil laahu in shaaa'a wa maaa antum bimu'jizeen
ayahs.en: He said, "Allah will only bring it to you if He wills, and you will not cause [Him] failure.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا يَنۡفَعُكُمۡ نُصۡحِيۡ٘ اِنۡ اَرَدۡتُّ اَنۡ اَنۡصَحَ لَكُمۡ اِنۡ كَانَ اللّٰهُ يُرِيۡدُ اَنۡ يُّغۡوِيَكُمۡؕ هُوَ رَبُّكُمۡࣞ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laa yanfa'ukum nusheee in arattu an ansaha lakum in kaanal laahu yureedu ai yughwi yakum; Huwa Rabbukum wa ilaihi turja'oon
ayahs.en: And my advice will not benefit you - although I wished to advise you - If Allah should intend to put you in error. He is your Lord, and to Him you will be returned."

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ افۡتَرٰىهُؕ قُلۡ اِنِ افۡتَرَيۡتُهٗ فَعَلَيَّ اِجۡرَامِيۡ وَاَنَا بَرِيۡٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُجۡرِمُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Am yaqooloonaf taraahu qul inif taraituhoo fa'alaiya ijraamee wa ana bareee'um mimmaa tujrimoon
ayahs.en: Or do they say [about Prophet Muhammad], "He invented it"? Say, "If I have invented it, then upon me is [the consequence of] my crime; but I am innocent of what [crimes] you commit."

ayahs.ar: وَاُوۡحِيَ اِلٰي نُوۡحٍ اَنَّهٗ لَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنَ مِنۡ قَوۡمِكَ اِلَّا مَنۡ قَدۡ اٰمَنَ فَلَا تَبۡتَئِسۡ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَفۡعَلُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa oohiya ilaa Noohin annahoo lany-yu'mina min qawmika illaa man qad aamana falaa tabta'is bimaa kaanoo yaf'aloon
ayahs.en: And it was revealed to Noah that, "No one will believe from your people except those who have already believed, so do not be distressed by what they have been doing.

ayahs.ar: وَاصۡنَعِ الۡفُلۡكَ بِاَعۡيُنِنَا وَوَحۡيِنَا وَلَا تُخَاطِبۡنِيۡ فِي الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡاۚ اِنَّهُمۡ مُّغۡرَقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wasna'il fulka bi-a'yuninaa wa wahyinaa wa laa tukhaa tibnee fil lazeena zalamoo; innahum mughraqoon
ayahs.en: And construct the ship under Our observation and Our inspiration and do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are [to be] drowned."

ayahs.ar: وَيَصۡنَعُ الۡفُلۡكَࣞ وَكُلَّمَا مَرَّ عَلَيۡهِ مَلَاٌ مِّنۡ قَوۡمِهٖ سَخِرُوۡا مِنۡهُؕ قَالَ اِنۡ تَسۡخَرُوۡا مِنَّا فَاِنَّا نَسۡخَرُ مِنۡكُمۡ كَمَا تَسۡخَرُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa yasn'ul fulka wa kullamaa marra 'alaihi malaum min qawmihee sakhiroo minh; qaala in taskharoo minnaa fa innaa naskharu minkum kamaa taskharoon
ayahs.en: And he constructed the ship, and whenever an assembly of the eminent of his people passed by him, they ridiculed him. He said, "If you ridicule us, then we will ridicule you just as you ridicule.

ayahs.ar: فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ مَنۡ يَّاۡتِيۡهِ عَذَابٌ يُّخۡزِيۡهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيۡهِ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Fasawfa ta'lamoona mai yaateehi 'azaabuny yaukhzeehi wa yahillu 'alaihi 'azaabum muqeem
ayahs.en: And you are going to know who will get a punishment that will disgrace him [on earth] and upon whom will descend an enduring punishment [in the Hereafter]."

ayahs.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا جَآءَ اَمۡرُنَا وَفَارَ التَّنُّوۡرُۙ قُلۡنَا احۡمِلۡ فِيۡهَا مِنۡ كُلٍّ زَوۡجَيۡنِ اثۡنَيۡنِ وَاَهۡلَكَ اِلَّا مَنۡ سَبَقَ عَلَيۡهِ الۡقَوۡلُ وَمَنۡ اٰمَنَؕ وَمَا٘ اٰمَنَ مَعَهٗ٘ اِلَّا قَلِيۡلٌ
ayahs.tl: Hattaaa izaa jaaa'a amrunaa wa faarat tannooru qulnah mil feehaa min kullin zawjainis naini wa ahlaka illaa man sabaqa 'alaihil qawlu wa man aaman; wa maaa aamana ma'ahooo illaa qaleel
ayahs.en: [So it was], until when Our command came and the oven overflowed, We said, "Load upon the ship of each [creature] two mates and your family, except those about whom the word has preceded, and [include] whoever has believed." But none had believed with him, except a few.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ ارۡكَبُوۡا فِيۡهَا بِسۡمِ اللّٰهِ مَجۡرٖىهَا وَمُرۡسٰىهَاؕ اِنَّ رَبِّيۡ لَغَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalar kaboo feehaa bismil laahi majraihaa wa mursaahaa; inna Rabbee la Ghafoorur Raheem
ayahs.en: And [Noah] said, "Embark therein; in the name of Allah is its course and its anchorage. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful."

ayahs.ar: وَهِيَ تَجۡرِيۡ بِهِمۡ فِيۡ مَوۡجٍ كَالۡجِبَالِࣞ وَنَادٰي نُوۡحُ اِۨبۡنَهٗ وَكَانَ فِيۡ مَعۡزِلٍ يّٰبُنَيَّ ارۡكَبۡ مَّعَنَا وَلَا تَكُنۡ مَّعَ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa hiya tajree bihim fee mawjin kaljibaali wa naadaa Noohunib nahoo wa kaana fee ma'ziliny yaa bunai yarkam ma'anaa wa laa takum ma'al kaafireen
ayahs.en: And it sailed with them through waves like mountains, and Noah called to his son who was apart [from them], "O my son, come aboard with us and be not with the disbelievers."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ سَاٰوِيۡ٘ اِلٰي جَبَلٍ يَّعۡصِمُنِيۡ مِنَ الۡمَآءِؕ قَالَ لَا عَاصِمَ الۡيَوۡمَ مِنۡ اَمۡرِ اللّٰهِ اِلَّا مَنۡ رَّحِمَۚ وَحَالَ بَيۡنَهُمَا الۡمَوۡجُ فَكَانَ مِنَ الۡمُغۡرَقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala sa aaweee ilaa jabaliny ya'simunee minal maaa'; qaala laa 'aasimal yawma min amril laahi illaa mar rahim; wa haala bainahumal mawju fakaana minal mughraqeen
ayahs.en: [But] he said, "I will take refuge on a mountain to protect me from the water." [Noah] said, "There is no protector today from the decree of Allah, except for whom He gives mercy." And the waves came between them, and he was among the drowned.

ayahs.ar: وَقِيۡلَ يٰ٘اَرۡضُ ابۡلَعِيۡ مَآءَكِ وَيٰسَمَآءُ اَقۡلِعِيۡ وَغِيۡضَ الۡمَآءُ وَقُضِيَ الۡاَمۡرُ وَاسۡتَوَتۡ عَلَي الۡجُوۡدِيِّ وَقِيۡلَ بُعۡدًا لِّلۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qeela yaaa ardubla'ee maaa'aki wa yaa samaaa'u aqi'ee wa gheedal maaa'u wa qudiyal amru wastawat 'alal joodiyyi wa qeela bu'dal lilqawmiz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and the ship came to rest on the [mountain of] Judiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people."

ayahs.ar: وَنَادٰي نُوۡحٌ رَّبَّهٗ فَقَالَ رَبِّ اِنَّ ابۡنِيۡ مِنۡ اَهۡلِيۡ وَاِنَّ وَعۡدَكَ الۡحَقُّ وَاَنۡتَ اَحۡكَمُ الۡحٰكِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa naadaa noohur Rabbahoo faqaala Rabbi innabnee min ahlee wa inna wa'dakal haqqu wa Anta ahkamul haakimeen
ayahs.en: And Noah called to his Lord and said, "My Lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, Your promise is true; and You are the most just of judges!"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يٰنُوۡحُ اِنَّهٗ لَيۡسَ مِنۡ اَهۡلِكَۚ اِنَّهٗ عَمَلٌ غَيۡرُ صَالِحٍࣗ فَلَا تَسۡـَٔلۡنِ مَا لَيۡسَ لَكَ بِهٖ عِلۡمٌؕ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَعِظُكَ اَنۡ تَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡجٰهِلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala yaa Noohu innahoo laisa min ahlika innahoo 'amalun ghairu saalihin falaa tas'alni mmaa laisa laka bihee 'ilmun inneee a'izuka an takoona minal jaahileen
ayahs.en: He said, "O Noah, indeed he is not of your family; indeed, he is [one whose] work was other than righteous, so ask Me not for that about which you have no knowledge. Indeed, I advise you, lest you be among the ignorant."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَعُوۡذُ بِكَ اَنۡ اَسۡـَٔلَكَ مَا لَيۡسَ لِيۡ بِهٖ عِلۡمٌؕ وَاِلَّا تَغۡفِرۡ لِيۡ وَتَرۡحَمۡنِيۡ٘ اَكُنۡ مِّنَ الۡخٰسِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala rabbi inneee a'oozu bika an as'alaka maa laisa lee bihee 'ilmunw wa illaa taghfir lee wa tarhamneee akum minal khaasireen
ayahs.en: [Noah] said, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from asking that of which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have mercy upon me, I will be among the losers."

ayahs.ar: قِيۡلَ يٰنُوۡحُ اهۡبِطۡ بِسَلٰمٍ مِّنَّا وَبَرَكٰتٍ عَلَيۡكَ وَعَلٰ٘ي اُمَمٍ مِّمَّنۡ مَّعَكَؕ وَاُمَمٌ سَنُمَتِّعُهُمۡ ثُمَّ يَمَسُّهُمۡ مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Qeela yaa Noohuh bit bisalaamim minnaa wa barakaatin 'alaika wa 'alaaa umamim mimmam ma'ak; wa umamun sanumatti'uhum summa yamassuhum minaa 'azaabun aleem
ayahs.en: It was said, "O Noah, disembark in security from Us and blessings upon you and upon nations [descending] from those with you. But other nations [of them] We will grant enjoyment; then there will touch them from Us a painful punishment."

ayahs.ar: تِلۡكَ مِنۡ اَنۭۡ بَآءِ الۡغَيۡبِ نُوۡحِيۡهَا٘ اِلَيۡكَۚ مَا كُنۡتَ تَعۡلَمُهَا٘ اَنۡتَ وَلَا قَوۡمُكَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِ هٰذَاؕۛ فَاصۡبِرۡؕۛ اِنَّ الۡعَاقِبَةَ لِلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Tilka min ambaaa'il ghaibi nooheehaaa ilaika maa kunta ta'lamuhaaaa anta wa laa qawmuka min qabli haazaa fasbir innal 'aaqibata lilmuttaqeen
ayahs.en: That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal to you, [O Muhammad]. You knew it not, neither you nor your people, before this. So be patient; indeed, the [best] outcome is for the righteous.

ayahs.ar: وَاِلٰي عَادٍ اَخَاهُمۡ هُوۡدًاؕ قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اِلٰهٍ غَيۡرُهٗؕ اِنۡ اَنۡتُمۡ اِلَّا مُفۡتَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa ilaa 'aadin akhaahum Hoodaa; qaala yaa qawmi' budul laaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghairuhooo in antum illaa muftaroon
ayahs.en: And to 'Aad [We sent] their brother Hud. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. You are not but inventors [of falsehood].

ayahs.ar: يٰقَوۡمِ لَا٘ اَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ اَجۡرًاؕ اِنۡ اَجۡرِيَ اِلَّا عَلَي الَّذِيۡ فَطَرَنِيۡؕ اَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yaa qawmi laaa as'alukum 'alaihi ajran in ajriya illaa 'alal lazee fataranee; afalaa ta'qiloon
ayahs.en: O my people, I do not ask you for it any reward. My reward is only from the one who created me. Then will you not reason?

ayahs.ar: وَيٰقَوۡمِ اسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡا رَبَّكُمۡ ثُمَّ تُوۡبُوۡ٘ا اِلَيۡهِ يُرۡسِلِ السَّمَآءَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ مِّدۡرَارًا وَّيَزِدۡكُمۡ قُوَّةً اِلٰي قُوَّتِكُمۡ وَلَا تَتَوَلَّوۡا مُجۡرِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa yaa qawmis taghfiroo Rabbakum summa toobooo ilaihi yursilis samaaa'a 'alaikum midraaranw wa yazidkum quwwatan ilaa quwwatikum wa laa tatawallaw mujrimeen
ayahs.en: And O my people, ask forgiveness of your Lord and then repent to Him. He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in showers and increase you in strength [added] to your strength. And do not turn away, [being] criminals."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰهُوۡدُ مَا جِئۡتَنَا بِبَيِّنَةٍ وَّمَا نَحۡنُ بِتَارِكِيۡ٘ اٰلِهَتِنَا عَنۡ قَوۡلِكَ وَمَا نَحۡنُ لَكَ بِمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo yaa Hoodu maa ji'tanaa bibaiyinatinw wa maa nahnu bitaarikeee aalihatinaa 'an qawlika wa maa nahnu laka bimu'mineen
ayahs.en: They said, "O Hud, you have not brought us clear evidence, and we are not ones to leave our gods on your say-so. Nor are we believers in you.

ayahs.ar: اِنۡ نَّقُوۡلُ اِلَّا اعۡتَرٰىكَ بَعۡضُ اٰلِهَتِنَا بِسُوۡٓءٍؕ قَالَ اِنِّيۡ٘ اُشۡهِدُ اللّٰهَ وَاشۡهَدُوۡ٘ا اَنِّيۡ بَرِيۡٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُشۡرِكُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: In naqoolu illa' taraaka ba'du aalihatinaa bisooo'; qaala inneee ushhidul laaha wash hadooo annee bareee'um mimmaa tushrikoon
ayahs.en: We only say that some of our gods have possessed you with evil." He said, "Indeed, I call Allah to witness, and witness [yourselves] that I am free from whatever you associate with Allah

ayahs.ar: مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ فَكِيۡدُوۡنِيۡ جَمِيۡعًا ثُمَّ لَا تُنۡظِرُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Min doonihee fakeedoonee jamee'an summa laa tunziroon
ayahs.en: Other than Him. So plot against me all together; then do not give me respite.

ayahs.ar: اِنِّيۡ تَوَكَّلۡتُ عَلَي اللّٰهِ رَبِّيۡ وَرَبِّكُمۡؕ مَا مِنۡ دَآبَّةٍ اِلَّا هُوَ اٰخِذٌۭ بِنَاصِيَتِهَاؕ اِنَّ رَبِّيۡ عَلٰي صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Innee tawakkaltu 'alallaahi Rabbee wa Rabbikum; maa min daaabbatin illaa Huwa aakhizum binaasiyatihaa; inna Rabbee 'alaa Siraatim mustaqeem
ayahs.en: Indeed, I have relied upon Allah, my Lord and your Lord. There is no creature but that He holds its forelock. Indeed, my Lord is on a path [that is] straight."

ayahs.ar: فَاِنۡ تَوَلَّوۡا فَقَدۡ اَبۡلَغۡتُكُمۡ مَّا٘ اُرۡسِلۡتُ بِهٖ٘ اِلَيۡكُمۡؕ وَيَسۡتَخۡلِفُ رَبِّيۡ قَوۡمًا غَيۡرَكُمۡۚ وَلَا تَضُرُّوۡنَهٗ شَيۡـًٔاؕ اِنَّ رَبِّيۡ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ حَفِيۡظٌ
ayahs.tl: Fa in tawallaw faqad ablaghtukum maaa ursiltu biheee ilaikum; wa yastakhlifu Rabbee qawman ghairakum wa laa tadur roonahoo shai'aa; inna Rabbee 'alaa kulli shai'in Hafeez
ayahs.en: But if they turn away, [say], "I have already conveyed that with which I was sent to you. My Lord will give succession to a people other than you, and you will not harm Him at all. Indeed my Lord is, over all things, Guardian."

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ اَمۡرُنَا نَجَّيۡنَا هُوۡدًا وَّالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا مَعَهٗ بِرَحۡمَةٍ مِّنَّاۚ وَنَجَّيۡنٰهُمۡ مِّنۡ عَذَابٍ غَلِيۡظٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa lammaa jaaa'a amrunaa najainaa Hoodanw wallazeena aamanoo ma'ahoo birahmatim minnaa wa najainaahum min 'azaabin ghaleez
ayahs.en: And when Our command came, We saved Hud and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us; and We saved them from a harsh punishment.

ayahs.ar: وَتِلۡكَ عَادٌ جَحَدُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَعَصَوۡا رُسُلَهٗ وَاتَّبَعُوۡ٘ا اَمۡرَ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيۡدٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa tilka 'aad, jahadoo bi Aayaati Rabbihim wa 'asaw Rusulahoo wattaba'ooo amra kulli jabbaarin 'aneed
ayahs.en: And that was 'Aad, who rejected the signs of their Lord and disobeyed His messengers and followed the order of every obstinate tyrant.

ayahs.ar: وَاُتۡبِعُوۡا فِيۡ هٰذِهِ الدُّنۡيَا لَعۡنَةً وَّيَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِؕ اَلَا٘ اِنَّ عَادًا كَفَرُوۡا رَبَّهُمۡؕ اَلَا بُعۡدًا لِّعَادٍ قَوۡمِ هُوۡدٍࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa utbi'oo fee haazihid dunyaa la'natanw wa Yawmal Qiyaamah; alaaa inna 'Aadan kafaroo Rabbahum; alaa bu'dal li 'Aadin qawmin Hood
ayahs.en: And they were [therefore] followed in this world with a curse and [as well] on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, 'Aad denied their Lord; then away with 'Aad, the people of Hud.

ayahs.ar: وَاِلٰي ثَمُوۡدَ اَخَاهُمۡ صٰلِحًاۘ قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اِلٰهٍ غَيۡرُهٗؕ هُوَ اَنۡشَاَكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاَرۡضِ وَاسۡتَعۡمَرَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا فَاسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡهُ ثُمَّ تُوۡبُوۡ٘ا اِلَيۡهِؕ اِنَّ رَبِّيۡ قَرِيۡبٌ مُّجِيۡبٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa ilaa Samooda akhaahum Saalihaa; qaala yaa qawmi' budul laaha maa lakum min ilaahim ghairuhoo Huwa ansha akum minal ardi wasta' marakum feehaa fastaghfiroohu summa toobooo ilaih; inna Rabbee Qareebum Mujeeb
ayahs.en: And to Thamud [We sent] their brother Salih. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. He has produced you from the earth and settled you in it, so ask forgiveness of Him and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is near and responsive."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰصٰلِحُ قَدۡ كُنۡتَ فِيۡنَا مَرۡجُوًّا قَبۡلَ هٰذَا٘ اَتَنۡهٰىنَا٘ اَنۡ نَّعۡبُدَ مَا يَعۡبُدُ اٰبَآؤُنَا وَاِنَّنَا لَفِيۡ شَكٍّ مِّمَّا تَدۡعُوۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡهِ مُرِيۡبٍ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo yaa Saalihu qad kunta feenaa marjuwwan qabla haazaaa atanhaanaaa an na'bu da maa ya'budu aabaaa'unaa wa innanaa lafee shakkim mimmaa tad'oonaaa ilaihi mureeb
ayahs.en: They said, "O Salih, you were among us a man of promise before this. Do you forbid us to worship what our fathers worshipped? And indeed we are, about that to which you invite us, in disquieting doubt."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اَرَءَيۡتُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُ عَلٰي بَيِّنَةٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّيۡ وَاٰتٰىنِيۡ مِنۡهُ رَحۡمَةً فَمَنۡ يَّنۡصُرُنِيۡ مِنَ اللّٰهِ اِنۡ عَصَيۡتُهٗࣞ فَمَا تَزِيۡدُوۡنَنِيۡ غَيۡرَ تَخۡسِيۡرٍ
ayahs.tl: Qaala yaa qawmi ara'aytum in kuntu 'alaa baiyinatim mir Rabbee wa aataanee minhu rahmatan famai yansurunee minal laahi in 'asaituhoo famaa tazeedoonanee ghaira takhseer
ayahs.en: He said, "O my people, have you considered: if I should be upon clear evidence from my Lord and He has given me mercy from Himself, who would protect me from Allah if I disobeyed Him? So you would not increase me except in loss.

ayahs.ar: وَيٰقَوۡمِ هٰذِهٖ نَاقَةُ اللّٰهِ لَكُمۡ اٰيَةً فَذَرُوۡهَا تَاۡكُلۡ فِيۡ٘ اَرۡضِ اللّٰهِ وَلَا تَمَسُّوۡهَا بِسُوۡٓءٍ فَيَاۡخُذَكُمۡ عَذَابٌ قَرِيۡبٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa yaa qawmi haazihee naaqatul laahi lakum aayatan fazaroohaa taakul feee ardil laahi wa laa tamassoohaa bisooo'in fa yaakhuzakum azaabun qareeb
ayahs.en: And O my people, this is the she-camel of Allah - [she is] to you a sign. So let her feed upon Allah 's earth and do not touch her with harm, or you will be taken by an impending punishment."

ayahs.ar: فَعَقَرُوۡهَا فَقَالَ تَمَتَّعُوۡا فِيۡ دَارِكُمۡ ثَلٰثَةَ اَيَّامٍؕ ذٰلِكَ وَعۡدٌ غَيۡرُ مَكۡذُوۡبٍ
ayahs.tl: Fa 'aqaroohaa faqaala tamatta'oo fee daarikum salaasata aiyaamin zaalika wa'dun ghairu makzoob
ayahs.en: But they hamstrung her, so he said, "Enjoy yourselves in your homes for three days. That is a promise not to be denied."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ اَمۡرُنَا نَجَّيۡنَا صٰلِحًا وَّالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا مَعَهٗ بِرَحۡمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَمِنۡ خِزۡيِ يَوۡمِئِذٍؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الۡقَوِيُّ الۡعَزِيۡزُ
ayahs.tl: Falammaa jaaa'a amrunaa najjainaa Saalihanw wal lazeena aamanoo ma'ahoo birahmatim minnaa wa min khizyi Yawmi'iz inna Rabbaka Huwal Qawiyyul 'Azeez
ayahs.en: So when Our command came, We saved Salih and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us, and [saved them] from the disgrace of that day. Indeed, it is your Lord who is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.

ayahs.ar: وَاَخَذَ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوا الصَّيۡحَةُ فَاَصۡبَحُوۡا فِيۡ دِيَارِهِمۡ جٰثِمِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa akhazal lazeena zalamus saihatu fa asbahoo fee diyaarihim jaasimeena
ayahs.en: And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone

ayahs.ar: كَاَنۡ لَّمۡ يَغۡنَوۡا فِيۡهَاؕ اَلَا٘ اِنَّ ثَمُوۡدَا۠ كَفَرُوۡا رَبَّهُمۡؕ اَلَا بُعۡدًا لِّثَمُوۡدَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Ka al lam yaghnaw feehaaa; alaaa inna Samooda kafaroo Rabbahum; alaa bu'dal li Samood.
ayahs.en: As if they had never prospered therein. Unquestionably, Thamud denied their Lord; then, away with Thamud.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُنَا٘ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ بِالۡبُشۡرٰي قَالُوۡا سَلٰمًاؕ قَالَ سَلٰمٌ فَمَا لَبِثَ اَنۡ جَآءَ بِعِجۡلٍ حَنِيۡذٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad jaaa'at Rusulunaaa Ibraaheema bilbushraa qaaloo salaaman qaala salaamun famaa labisa an jaaa'a bi'ijin haneez
ayahs.en: And certainly did Our messengers come to Abraham with good tidings; they said, "Peace." He said, "Peace," and did not delay in bringing [them] a roasted calf.

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا رَاٰ٘ اَيۡدِيَهُمۡ لَا تَصِلُ اِلَيۡهِ نَكِرَهُمۡ وَاَوۡجَسَ مِنۡهُمۡ خِيۡفَةًؕ قَالُوۡا لَا تَخَفۡ اِنَّا٘ اُرۡسِلۡنَا٘ اِلٰي قَوۡمِ لُوۡطٍؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Falammaa ra aaa aidiyahum laa tasilu ilaihi nakirahum wa awjasa minhum kheefah; qaaloo la takhaf innaaa ursilnaaa ilaa qawmi Loot
ayahs.en: But when he saw their hands not reaching for it, he distrusted them and felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not. We have been sent to the people of Lot."

ayahs.ar: وَامۡرَاَتُهٗ قَآئِمَةٌ فَضَحِكَتۡ فَبَشَّرۡنٰهَا بِاِسۡحٰقَۙ وَمِنۡ وَّرَآءِ اِسۡحٰقَ يَعۡقُوۡبَ
ayahs.tl: Wamra atuhoo qaaa'imatun fadahikat fabashsharnaahaa bi Ishaaqa wa minw waraaa'i Ishaaqa Ya'qoob
ayahs.en: And his Wife was standing, and she smiled. Then We gave her good tidings of Isaac and after Isaac, Jacob.

ayahs.ar: قَالَتۡ يٰوَيۡلَتٰ٘ي ءَاَلِدُ وَاَنَا عَجُوۡزٌ وَّهٰذَا بَعۡلِيۡ شَيۡخًاؕ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَشَيۡءٌ عَجِيۡبٌ
ayahs.tl: Qaalat yaa wailataaa 'aalidu wa ana 'ajoozunw wa haaza ba'lee shaikhan inna haazaa lashai'un 'ajeeb
ayahs.en: She said, "Woe to me! Shall I give birth while I am an old woman and this, my husband, is an old man? Indeed, this is an amazing thing!"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اَتَعۡجَبِيۡنَ مِنۡ اَمۡرِ اللّٰهِ رَحۡمَتُ اللّٰهِ وَبَرَكٰتُهٗ عَلَيۡكُمۡ اَهۡلَ الۡبَيۡتِؕ اِنَّهٗ حَمِيۡدٌ مَّجِيۡدٌ
ayahs.tl: Qaalooo ata'jabeena min amril laahi rahmatul laahi wa barakaatuho 'alaikum Ahlal Bayt; innahoo Hameedum Majeed
ayahs.en: They said, "Are you amazed at the decree of Allah? May the mercy of Allah and His blessings be upon you, people of the house. Indeed, He is Praiseworthy and Honorable."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ عَنۡ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ الرَّوۡعُ وَجَآءَتۡهُ الۡبُشۡرٰي يُجَادِلُنَا فِيۡ قَوۡمِ لُوۡطٍؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Falammaa zahaba an Ibraaheemar raw'u wa jaaa'at hul bushraaa yujaadilunaa fee qawmi Loot
ayahs.en: And when the fright had left Abraham and the good tidings had reached him, he began to argue with Us concerning the people of Lot.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ لَحَلِيۡمٌ اَوَّاهٌ مُّنِيۡبٌ
ayahs.tl: Inna Ibraaheema lahaleemun awwwaahum muneeb
ayahs.en: Indeed, Abraham was forbearing, grieving and [frequently] returning [to Allah].

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اِبۡرٰهِيۡمُ اَعۡرِضۡ عَنۡ هٰذَاۚ اِنَّهٗ قَدۡ جَآءَ اَمۡرُ رَبِّكَۚ وَاِنَّهُمۡ اٰتِيۡهِمۡ عَذَابٌ غَيۡرُ مَرۡدُوۡدٍ
ayahs.tl: Yaaa Ibraaheemu a'rid 'an haazaaa innahoo qad jaaa'a amru Rabbika wa innahum aateehim 'azaabun ghairun mardood
ayahs.en: [The angels said], "O Abraham, give up this [plea]. Indeed, the command of your Lord has come, and indeed, there will reach them a punishment that cannot be repelled."

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُنَا لُوۡطًا سِيۡٓءَ بِهِمۡ وَضَاقَ بِهِمۡ ذَرۡعًا وَّقَالَ هٰذَا يَوۡمٌ عَصِيۡبٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa lammaa jaaa'at Rusulunaa Lootan seee'a bihim wa daaqa bihim zar'anw wa qaala haazaa yawmun 'aseeb
ayahs.en: And when Our messengers, [the angels], came to Lot, he was anguished for them and felt for them great discomfort and said, "This is a trying day."

ayahs.ar: وَجَآءَهٗ قَوۡمُهٗ يُهۡرَعُوۡنَ اِلَيۡهِؕ وَمِنۡ قَبۡلُ كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ السَّيِّاٰتِؕ قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِيۡ هُنَّ اَطۡهَرُ لَكُمۡ فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَلَا تُخۡزُوۡنِ فِيۡ ضَيۡفِيۡؕ اَلَيۡسَ مِنۡكُمۡ رَجُلٌ رَّشِيۡدٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa jaaa'ahoo qawmuhoo yuhra'oona ilaihi wa min qablu kaanoo ya'maloonas saiyiaat; qaala yaa qawmi haaa'ulaaa'i banaatee hunna atharu lakum fattaqul laaha wa laa tukhzooni fee daifee alaisa minkum rajulur rasheed
ayahs.en: And his people came hastening to him, and before [this] they had been doing evil deeds. He said, "O my people, these are my daughters; they are purer for you. So fear Allah and do not disgrace me concerning my guests. Is there not among you a man of reason?"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا لَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتَ مَا لَنَا فِيۡ بَنَاتِكَ مِنۡ حَقٍّۚ وَاِنَّكَ لَتَعۡلَمُ مَا نُرِيۡدُ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo laqad 'alimta maa lanaa fee banastika min haqq, wa innaka lata'lamu maa nureed
ayahs.en: They said, "You have already known that we have not concerning your daughters any claim, and indeed, you know what we want."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَوۡ اَنَّ لِيۡ بِكُمۡ قُوَّةً اَوۡ اٰوِيۡ٘ اِلٰي رُكۡنٍ شَدِيۡدٍ
ayahs.tl: Qaala law anna lee bikum quwwatan aw aaweee ilaa ruknin shadeed
ayahs.en: He said, "If only I had against you some power or could take refuge in a strong support."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰلُوۡطُ اِنَّا رُسُلُ رَبِّكَ لَنۡ يَّصِلُوۡ٘ا اِلَيۡكَ فَاَسۡرِ بِاَهۡلِكَ بِقِطۡعٍ مِّنَ الَّيۡلِ وَلَا يَلۡتَفِتۡ مِنۡكُمۡ اَحَدٌ اِلَّا امۡرَاَتَكَؕ اِنَّهٗ مُصِيۡبُهَا مَا٘ اَصَابَهُمۡؕ اِنَّ مَوۡعِدَهُمُ الصُّبۡحُؕ اَلَيۡسَ الصُّبۡحُ بِقَرِيۡبٍ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo yaa Lootu innaa Rusulu Rabbika lai yasiloo ilaika fa asri bi ahlika biqit 'im minal laili wa laa yaltafit minkum ahadun illam ra ataka innahoo museebuhaa maaa asaabahum; inna maw'i dahumus subh; alaisas subhu biqareeb
ayahs.en: The angels said, "O Lot, indeed we are messengers of your Lord; [therefore], they will never reach you. So set out with your family during a portion of the night and let not any among you look back - except your wife; indeed, she will be struck by that which strikes them. Indeed, their appointment is [for] the morning. Is not the morning near?"

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ اَمۡرُنَا جَعَلۡنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَاَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهَا حِجَارَةً مِّنۡ سِجِّيۡلٍ ࣢ۙ مَّنۡضُوۡدٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Falammaa jaaa'a amrunaa ja'alnaa 'aaliyahaa saafilahaa wa amtamaa 'alaihaa hijaaratam min sijjeelim mandood
ayahs.en: So when Our command came, We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of layered hard clay, [which were]

ayahs.ar: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِنۡدَ رَبِّكَؕ وَمَا هِيَ مِنَ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ بِبَعِيۡدٍࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Musawwamatan 'inda Rabbik; wa maa hiya minaz zaalimena biba'eed
ayahs.en: Marked from your Lord. And Allah 's punishment is not from the wrongdoers [very] far.

ayahs.ar: وَاِلٰي مَدۡيَنَ اَخَاهُمۡ شُعَيۡبًاؕ قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اِلٰهٍ غَيۡرُهٗؕ وَلَا تَنۡقُصُوا الۡمِكۡيَالَ وَالۡمِيۡزَانَ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَرٰىكُمۡ بِخَيۡرٍ وَّاِنِّيۡ٘ اَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ مُّحِيۡطٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa ilaa Madyana akhaahum Shu'aibaa; qaala yaa qawmi' budul laaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghairuhoo wa laa tanqusul mikyaala walmeezaan; inneee araakum bikhairinw wa innee akhaafu 'alaikum 'azaaba Yawmim muheet
ayahs.en: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shu'ayb. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. And do not decrease from the measure and the scale. Indeed, I see you in prosperity, but indeed, I fear for you the punishment of an all-encompassing Day.

ayahs.ar: وَيٰقَوۡمِ اَوۡفُوا الۡمِكۡيَالَ وَالۡمِيۡزَانَ بِالۡقِسۡطِ وَلَا تَبۡخَسُوا النَّاسَ اَشۡيَآءَهُمۡ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa yaa qawmi awful mikyaala walmeezaana bilqisti wa laa tabkhasun naasa ashyaaa'ahum wa laa ta'saw fil ardi mufsideen
ayahs.en: And O my people, give full measure and weight in justice and do not deprive the people of their due and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption.

ayahs.ar: بَقِيَّتُ اللّٰهِ خَيۡرٌ لَّكُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ ࣢ۚ وَمَا٘ اَنَا عَلَيۡكُمۡ بِحَفِيۡظٍ
ayahs.tl: Baqiyyatul laahi khairul lakum in kuntum mu'mineen; wa maa ana 'alaikum bihafeez
ayahs.en: What remains [lawful] from Allah is best for you, if you would be believers. But I am not a guardian over you."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰشُعَيۡبُ اَصَلٰوتُكَ تَاۡمُرُكَ اَنۡ نَّتۡرُكَ مَا يَعۡبُدُ اٰبَآؤُنَا٘ اَوۡ اَنۡ نَّفۡعَلَ فِيۡ٘ اَمۡوَالِنَا مَا نَشٰٓؤُاؕ اِنَّكَ لَاَنۡتَ الۡحَلِيۡمُ الرَّشِيۡدُ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo yaa Shu'aybu asalaatuka taamuruka an natruka maa ya'budu aabaaa'unaaa aw an naf'ala feee amwaalinaa maa nashaaa'oo innaka la antal haleemur rasheed
ayahs.en: They said, "O Shu'ayb, does your prayer command you that we should leave what our fathers worship or not do with our wealth what we please? Indeed, you are the forbearing, the discerning!"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اَرَءَيۡتُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُ عَلٰي بَيِّنَةٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّيۡ وَرَزَقَنِيۡ مِنۡهُ رِزۡقًا حَسَنًاؕ وَمَا٘ اُرِيۡدُ اَنۡ اُخَالِفَكُمۡ اِلٰي مَا٘ اَنۡهٰىكُمۡ عَنۡهُؕ اِنۡ اُرِيۡدُ اِلَّا الۡاِصۡلَاحَ مَا اسۡتَطَعۡتُؕ وَمَا تَوۡفِيۡقِيۡ٘ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِؕ عَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُ وَاِلَيۡهِ اُنِيۡبُ
ayahs.tl: Qaala yaa qawmi ara'aitum in kuntu 'alaa baiyinatim mir Rabbee wa razaqanee minhu rizqan hasanaa; wa maaa ureedu an ukhaalifakum ilaa maaa anhaakum 'anh; in ureedu illal islaaha mastata't; wa maa tawfeeqeee illaa billaah; 'alaihi tawakkaltu wa ilaihi uneeb
ayahs.en: He said, "O my people, have you considered: if I am upon clear evidence from my Lord and He has provided me with a good provision from Him...? And I do not intend to differ from you in that which I have forbidden you; I only intend reform as much as I am able. And my success is not but through Allah. Upon him I have relied, and to Him I return.

ayahs.ar: وَيٰقَوۡمِ لَا يَجۡرِمَنَّكُمۡ شِقَاقِيۡ٘ اَنۡ يُّصِيۡبَكُمۡ مِّثۡلُ مَا٘ اَصَابَ قَوۡمَ نُوۡحٍ اَوۡ قَوۡمَ هُوۡدٍ اَوۡ قَوۡمَ صٰلِحٍؕ وَمَا قَوۡمُ لُوۡطٍ مِّنۡكُمۡ بِبَعِيۡدٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa yaa qawmi laa yajri mannakum shiqaaqeee ai yuseebakum mislu maaa asaaba qawma Noohin aw qawma Hoodin aw qawma Saalih; wa maa qawmu Lootim minkum biba'eed
ayahs.en: And O my people, let not [your] dissension from me cause you to be struck by that similar to what struck the people of Noah or the people of Hud or the people of Salih. And the people of Lot are not from you far away.

ayahs.ar: وَاسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡا رَبَّكُمۡ ثُمَّ تُوۡبُوۡ٘ا اِلَيۡهِؕ اِنَّ رَبِّيۡ رَحِيۡمٌ وَّدُوۡدٌ
ayahs.tl: Wastaghfiroo Rabbakum summa toobooo ilaih; inna Rabbee Raheemunw Wadood
ayahs.en: And ask forgiveness of your Lord and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is Merciful and Affectionate."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰشُعَيۡبُ مَا نَفۡقَهُ كَثِيۡرًا مِّمَّا تَقُوۡلُ وَاِنَّا لَنَرٰىكَ فِيۡنَا ضَعِيۡفًاۚ وَلَوۡلَا رَهۡطُكَ لَرَجَمۡنٰكَؗ وَمَا٘ اَنۡتَ عَلَيۡنَا بِعَزِيۡزٍ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo yaa Shu'aibu maa nafqahu kaseeram mimmaa taqoolu wa innaa lanaraaka feenaa da'eefanw wa law laa rahtuka larajamnaaka wa maaa anta 'alainaa bi'azeez
ayahs.en: They said, "O Shu'ayb, we do not understand much of what you say, and indeed, we consider you among us as weak. And if not for your family, we would have stoned you [to death]; and you are not to us one respected."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اَرَهۡطِيۡ٘ اَعَزُّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ مِّنَ اللّٰهِؕ وَاتَّخَذۡتُمُوۡهُ وَرَآءَكُمۡ ظِهۡرِيًّاؕ اِنَّ رَبِّيۡ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ مُحِيۡطٌ
ayahs.tl: Qaala yaa qawmi arahteee a'azzu 'alaikum minal laahi wattakhaztumoohu waraaa'akum zihriyyan inna Rabbee bimaa ta'maloona muheet
ayahs.en: He said, "O my people, is my family more respected for power by you than Allah? But you put Him behind your backs [in neglect]. Indeed, my Lord is encompassing of what you do.

ayahs.ar: وَيٰقَوۡمِ اعۡمَلُوۡا عَلٰي مَكَانَتِكُمۡ اِنِّيۡ عَامِلٌؕ سَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ مَنۡ يَّاۡتِيۡهِ عَذَابٌ يُّخۡزِيۡهِ وَمَنۡ هُوَ كَاذِبٌؕ وَارۡتَقِبُوۡ٘ا اِنِّيۡ مَعَكُمۡ رَقِيۡبٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa yaa qawmi' maloo 'alaa makaanatikum innee 'aamilun sawfa ta'lamoona mai yaateehi 'azaabuny yukhzeehi wa man huwa kaazib; wartaqibooo innnee ma'akum raqeeb
ayahs.en: And O my people, work according to your position; indeed, I am working. You are going to know to whom will come a punishment that will disgrace him and who is a liar. So watch; indeed, I am with you a watcher, [awaiting the outcome]."

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ اَمۡرُنَا نَجَّيۡنَا شُعَيۡبًا وَّالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا مَعَهٗ بِرَحۡمَةٍ مِّنَّاۚ وَاَخَذَتِ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوا الصَّيۡحَةُ فَاَصۡبَحُوۡا فِيۡ دِيَارِهِمۡ جٰثِمِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa lammaa jaaa'a amrunaa najjainaa shu'aibanw wal lazeena aamanoo ma'ahoo birahmatim minnaa wa akhazatil lazeena zalamus saihatu fa asbahoo fee diyaarihim jaasimeen
ayahs.en: And when Our command came, We saved Shu'ayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us. And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone

ayahs.ar: كَاَنۡ لَّمۡ يَغۡنَوۡا فِيۡهَاؕ اَلَا بُعۡدًا لِّمَدۡيَنَ كَمَا بَعِدَتۡ ثَمُوۡدُࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Ka-al-lam yaghnaw feehaaa; alaa bu'dal li Madyana Kamaa ba'idat Samood
ayahs.en: As if they had never prospered therein. Then, away with Madyan as Thamud was taken away.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوۡسٰي بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad arsalnaa Moosaa bi Aayaatinaa wa sultaanim mubeen
ayahs.en: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority

ayahs.ar: اِلٰي فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَا۠ئِهٖ فَاتَّبَعُوۡ٘ا اَمۡرَ فِرۡعَوۡنَۚ وَمَا٘ اَمۡرُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ بِرَشِيۡدٍ
ayahs.tl: Ilaa Fir'awna wa mala'ihee fattaba'ooo amra Fir'awna wa maaa amru Fir'awna birasheed
ayahs.en: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they followed the command of Pharaoh, and the command of Pharaoh was not [at all] discerning.

ayahs.ar: يَقۡدُمُ قَوۡمَهٗ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ فَاَوۡرَدَهُمُ النَّارَؕ وَبِئۡسَ الۡوِرۡدُ الۡمَوۡرُوۡدُ
ayahs.tl: Yaqdumu qawmahoo Yawmal Qiyaamati fa awrada humun Naara wa bi'sal wirdul mawrood
ayahs.en: He will precede his people on the Day of Resurrection and lead them into the Fire; and wretched is the place to which they are led.

ayahs.ar: وَاُتۡبِعُوۡا فِيۡ هٰذِهٖ لَعۡنَةً وَّيَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِؕ بِئۡسَ الرِّفۡدُ الۡمَرۡفُوۡدُ
ayahs.tl: Wa utbi'oo fee haazihee la'natanw wa Yawmal Qiyaamah; bi'sar rifdul marfood
ayahs.en: And they were followed in this [world] with a curse and on the Day of Resurrection. And wretched is the gift which is given.

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكَ مِنۡ اَنۭۡ بَآءِ الۡقُرٰي نَقُصُّهٗ عَلَيۡكَ مِنۡهَا قَآئِمٌ وَّحَصِيۡدٌ
ayahs.tl: Zaalika min ambaaa'il quraa naqussuhoo 'alaika minhaa qaaa'imunw wa haseed
ayahs.en: That is from the news of the cities, which We relate to you; of them, some are [still] standing and some are [as] a harvest [mowed down].

ayahs.ar: وَمَا ظَلَمۡنٰهُمۡ وَلٰكِنۡ ظَلَمُوۡ٘ا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ فَمَا٘ اَغۡنَتۡ عَنۡهُمۡ اٰلِهَتُهُمُ الَّتِيۡ يَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ شَيۡءٍ لَّمَّا جَآءَ اَمۡرُ رَبِّكَؕ وَمَا زَادُوۡهُمۡ غَيۡرَ تَتۡبِيۡبٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa zalamnaahum wa laakin zalamooo anfusahum famaaa aghnat 'anhum aalihatuhumul latee yad'oona min doonil laahi min shai'il lammaa jaaa'a amru Rabbika wa maa zaadoohum ghaira tatbeeb
ayahs.en: And We did not wrong them, but they wronged themselves. And they were not availed at all by their gods which they invoked other than Allah when there came the command of your Lord. And they did not increase them in other than ruin.

ayahs.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ اَخۡذُ رَبِّكَ اِذَا٘ اَخَذَ الۡقُرٰي وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٌؕ اِنَّ اَخۡذَهٗ٘ اَلِيۡمٌ شَدِيۡدٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa kazaalika akhzu Rabbika izaaa akhazal quraa wa hiya zaalimah; inna akhzahooo aleemun shadeed
ayahs.en: And thus is the seizure of your Lord when He seizes the cities while they are committing wrong. Indeed, His seizure is painful and severe.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّمَنۡ خَافَ عَذَابَ الۡاٰخِرَةِؕ ذٰلِكَ يَوۡمٌ مَّجۡمُوۡعٌۙ لَّهُ النَّاسُ وَذٰلِكَ يَوۡمٌ مَّشۡهُوۡدٌ
ayahs.tl: Inna fee zaalika la aayatal liman khaafa 'azaabal Aakhirah; zaalika Yawmum majmoo'ul lahun naasu wa zaalika Yawmum mashhood
ayahs.en: Indeed in that is a sign for those who fear the punishment of the Hereafter. That is a Day for which the people will be collected, and that is a Day [which will be] witnessed.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا نُؤَخِّرُهٗ٘ اِلَّا لِاَجَلٍ مَّعۡدُوۡدٍؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maa nu'akhkhiruhooo illaa li ajalim ma'dood
ayahs.en: And We do not delay it except for a limited term.

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ يَاۡتِ لَا تَكَلَّمُ نَفۡسٌ اِلَّا بِاِذۡنِهٖۚ فَمِنۡهُمۡ شَقِيٌّ وَّسَعِيۡدٌ
ayahs.tl: Yawma yaati laa takallamu nafsun illaa bi iznih; faminhum shaqiyyunw wa sa'eed
ayahs.en: The Day it comes no soul will speak except by His permission. And among them will be the wretched and the prosperous.

ayahs.ar: فَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ شَقُوۡا فَفِي النَّارِ لَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا زَفِيۡرٌ وَّشَهِيۡقٌۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa ammal lazeena shaqoo fafin Naari lahum feehaa zafeerunw wa shaheeq
ayahs.en: As for those who were [destined to be] wretched, they will be in the Fire. For them therein is [violent] exhaling and inhaling.

ayahs.ar: خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمٰوٰتُ وَالۡاَرۡضُ اِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيۡدُ
ayahs.tl: Khaalideena feehaa maa daamatis samaawaatu wal ardu illaa maa shaaa'a Rabbuk; inna Rabbaka fa' 'aalul limaa yureed
ayahs.en: [They will be] abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord should will. Indeed, your Lord is an effecter of what He intends.

ayahs.ar: وَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ سُعِدُوۡا فَفِي الۡجَنَّةِ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمٰوٰتُ وَالۡاَرۡضُ اِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَؕ عَطَآءً غَيۡرَ مَجۡذُوۡذٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa ammal lazeena su'idoo fafil Jannati khaalideena feehaa maa daamatis samaawaatu wal ardu illaa maa shaaa'a Rabbuk; ataaa'an ghaira majzooz
ayahs.en: And as for those who were [destined to be] prosperous, they will be in Paradise, abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord should will - a bestowal uninterrupted.

ayahs.ar: فَلَا تَكُ فِيۡ مِرۡيَةٍ مِّمَّا يَعۡبُدُ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِؕ مَا يَعۡبُدُوۡنَ اِلَّا كَمَا يَعۡبُدُ اٰبَآؤُهُمۡ مِّنۡ قَبۡلُؕ وَاِنَّا لَمُوَفُّوۡهُمۡ نَصِيۡبَهُمۡ غَيۡرَ مَنۡقُوۡصٍࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Falaa taku fee miryatim mimmmaa ya'budu haaa'ulaaa'; maa ya'budoona illaa kamaa ya'budu aabaaa'uhum min qabl; wa innaa lamuwaf foohum naseebahum ghaira manqoos
ayahs.en: So do not be in doubt, [O Muhammad], as to what these [polytheists] are worshipping. They worship not except as their fathers worshipped before. And indeed, We will give them their share undiminished.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسَي الۡكِتٰبَ فَاخۡتُلِفَ فِيۡهِؕ وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتۡ مِنۡ رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُمۡؕ وَاِنَّهُمۡ لَفِيۡ شَكٍّ مِّنۡهُ مُرِيۡبٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad aatainaa Moosal Kitaaba fakhtulifa feeh; wa law laa Kalimatun sabaqat mir Rabbika laqudiya bainahum; wa innahum lafee shakkim minhu mureeb
ayahs.en: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture, but it came under disagreement. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it would have been judged between them. And indeed they are, concerning the Qur'an, in disquieting doubt.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّ كُلًّا لَّمَّا لَيُوَفِّيَنَّهُمۡ رَبُّكَ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡؕ اِنَّهٗ بِمَا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ خَبِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa inna kullal lammaa la yuwaffiyannahum Rabbuka a'maalahum; innahoo bimaa ya'maloona Khabeer
ayahs.en: And indeed, each [of the believers and disbelievers] - your Lord will fully compensate them for their deeds. Indeed, He is Acquainted with what they do.

ayahs.ar: فَاسۡتَقِمۡ كَمَا٘ اُمِرۡتَ وَمَنۡ تَابَ مَعَكَ وَلَا تَطۡغَوۡاؕ اِنَّهٗ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ بَصِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Fastaqim kamaaa umirta wa man taaba ma'aka wa laa tatghaw; innahoo bimaa ta'maloona Baseer
ayahs.en: So remain on a right course as you have been commanded, [you] and those who have turned back with you [to Allah], and do not transgress. Indeed, He is Seeing of what you do.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَرۡكَنُوۡ٘ا اِلَي الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا فَتَمَسَّكُمُ النَّارُۙ وَمَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ اَوۡلِيَآءَ ثُمَّ لَا تُنۡصَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laa tarkanooo ilal lazeena zalamoo fatamassa kumun Naaru wa maa lakum min doonil laahi min awliyaaa'a summa laa tunsaroon
ayahs.en: And do not incline toward those who do wrong, lest you be touched by the Fire, and you would not have other than Allah any protectors; then you would not be helped.

ayahs.ar: وَاَقِمِ الصَّلٰوةَ طَرَفَيِ النَّهَارِ وَزُلَفًا مِّنَ الَّيۡلِؕ اِنَّ الۡحَسَنٰتِ يُذۡهِبۡنَ السَّيِّاٰتِؕ ذٰلِكَ ذِكۡرٰي لِلذّٰكِرِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa aqimis Salaata tarafayin nahaari wa zulafam minal layl; innal hasanaati yuzhibnas saiyi aat; zaalika zikraa liz zaakireen
ayahs.en: And establish prayer at the two ends of the day and at the approach of the night. Indeed, good deeds do away with misdeeds. That is a reminder for those who remember.

ayahs.ar: وَاصۡبِرۡ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُضِيۡعُ اَجۡرَ الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wasbir fa innal laaha laa yudee'u ajral muhsineen
ayahs.en: And be patient, for indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good.

ayahs.ar: فَلَوۡلَا كَانَ مِنَ الۡقُرُوۡنِ مِنۡ قَبۡلِكُمۡ اُولُوۡا بَقِيَّةٍ يَّنۡهَوۡنَ عَنِ الۡفَسَادِ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ اِلَّا قَلِيۡلًا مِّمَّنۡ اَنۡجَيۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡۚ وَاتَّبَعَ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا مَا٘ اُتۡرِفُوۡا فِيۡهِ وَكَانُوۡا مُجۡرِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falw laa kaana minal qurooni min qablikum ooloo baqiyyatiny yanhawna 'anil fasaadi fil ardi illaa qaleelam mimman anjainaa minhum; wattaba'al lazeena zalamoo maaa utrifoo feehi wa kaanoo mujrimeen
ayahs.en: So why were there not among the generations before you those of enduring discrimination forbidding corruption on earth - except a few of those We saved from among them? But those who wronged pursued what luxury they were given therein, and they were criminals.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ لِيُهۡلِكَ الۡقُرٰي بِظُلۡمٍ وَّاَهۡلُهَا مُصۡلِحُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa kaana Rabbuka liyuhlikal quraa bizulminw wa ahluhaa muslihoon
ayahs.en: And your Lord would not have destroyed the cities unjustly while their people were reformers.

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ لَجَعَلَ النَّاسَ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً وَّلَا يَزَالُوۡنَ مُخۡتَلِفِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa law shaaa'a Rabbuka laja'alannnaasa ummatanw waa hidatanw wa laa yazaaloona mukhtalifeen
ayahs.en: And if your Lord had willed, He could have made mankind one community; but they will not cease to differ.

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا مَنۡ رَّحِمَ رَبُّكَؕ وَلِذٰلِكَ خَلَقَهُمۡؕ وَتَمَّتۡ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ لَاَمۡلَـَٔنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الۡجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Illaa mar rahima Rabbuk; wa lizaalika khalaqahum; wa tammat Kalimatu Rabbika la amla'ana Jahannama minal jinnati wannnaasi ajma'een
ayahs.en: Except whom your Lord has given mercy, and for that He created them. But the word of your Lord is to be fulfilled that, "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and men all together."

ayahs.ar: وَكُلًّا نَّقُصُّ عَلَيۡكَ مِنۡ اَنۭۡ بَآءِ الرُّسُلِ مَا نُثَبِّتُ بِهٖ فُؤَادَكَۚ وَجَآءَكَ فِيۡ هٰذِهِ الۡحَقُّ وَمَوۡعِظَةٌ وَّذِكۡرٰي لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa kullan naqussu 'alaika min ambaaa'ir Rusuli maa nusabbitu bihee fu'aadak; wa jaaa'aka fee haazihil haqqu wa maw'izatunw wa zikraa lilmu' mineen
ayahs.en: And each [story] We relate to you from the news of the messengers is that by which We make firm your heart. And there has come to you, in this, the truth and an instruction and a reminder for the believers.

ayahs.ar: وَقُلۡ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ اعۡمَلُوۡا عَلٰي مَكَانَتِكُمۡؕ اِنَّا عٰمِلُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qul lillazeena laa yu'minoona' maloo 'alaa makaanatikum innaa 'aamiloon
ayahs.en: And say to those who do not believe, "Work according to your position; indeed, we are working.

ayahs.ar: وَانۡتَظِرُوۡاۚ اِنَّا مُنۡتَظِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wantaziroo innaa mun taziroon
ayahs.en: And wait, indeed, we are waiting."

ayahs.ar: وَلِلّٰهِ غَيۡبُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَاِلَيۡهِ يُرۡجَعُ الۡاَمۡرُ كُلُّهٗ فَاعۡبُدۡهُ وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَيۡهِؕ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa lillaahi ghaibus samaawaati wal ardi wa ilaihi yurja'ul amru kulluhoo fa'bu-dhu wa tawakkal 'alaih; wa maa Rabbuka bighaafilin 'ammaa ta'maloon
ayahs.en: And to Allah belong the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth and to Him will be returned the matter, all of it, so worship Him and rely upon Him. And your Lord is not unaware of that which you do.
